proposed_local_proof1_2: For the automatic Lagrange branch assume AC. If d>=2, apply F6 simplex threshold supplier. If d=1 the reference simplex is (0,1). A class u in Wellp lies in W1p since ell>=1; the published representative supplier gives the unique absolutely continuous u* on[0,1]. For each x,t in[0,1], its integral identity and integral triangle inequality give |u*(x)|<=|u*(t)|+integral_0^1|Du|. Integrate in t over the unit interval and apply Holder (with the constant1, including p=1): |u*(x)|<=||u||Lp+||Du||Lp<=C||u||Wellp. The bound is uniform in x, so every finite set of nodes, including endpoints, gives bounded class-independent linear evaluations. For vector-valued finite-element data apply componentwise and combine the finitely many bounds. This proves the original d=1 automatic branch, including its stated ell>d/p subrange, without creating a new item or using a d>=2 theorem there.
